style_definition.primary_identity: Contemporary 2D fantasy character illustration with Art Nouveau-inspired botanical ornamentation, graphic architectural framing, elegant line art, and restrained digital coloring

historical_influences.art_nouveau: Borrow curved organic lines, floral framing, and decorative rhythm, not antique engraving or heavy metallic ornament
historical_influences.stained_glass: Borrow geometric segmentation and bold contour separation, not realistic glass textures
historical_influences.medieval_fantasy: Influence costumes and subject matter only, not the underlying rendering technique

rendering.technique: Precise ink-like outlines over flat digital color fills
rendering.dimensionality: Predominantly flat 2D with restrained volumetric modeling
rendering.surface: Clean digital illustration with extremely subtle grain

composition.subject_framing: Entire figure from head to feet
composition.subject_scale: The character occupies approximately 75-90% of the interior frame height
composition.pose: Natural but elegant, with a readable silhouette

body_proportions.feet: Visible and fully contained within the illustration
body_proportions.proportion_rule: Stylization should preserve recognizability and subject identity

spatial_design.foreground: Selective botanical silhouettes overlapping the lower subject
spatial_design.background: Decorative flat illustration with soft botanical or geometric elements

layout_constraints: Never crop the head or feet unless explicitly requested
Do not allow decorations to overpower the subject
Keep face and upper torso visually unobstructed
Do not default to a close-up portrait

framing.default_shape: Tall narrow rounded arch with a semicircular or slightly pointed top
framing.frame_style: Clean architectural outline inspired by stained glass
framing.border_color: White, ivory, or very pale cream
framing.secondary_contour: Thin dark line adjacent to the light frame
framing.border_ornamentation: Sparse, elegant, integrated into the composition

geometric_divisions.style: Sharp geometric segments and long straight lines
geometric_divisions.rule: Large geometric areas should remain visually uncluttered

outer_background.visual_role: Provide strong contrast against the pale architectural frame

external_contours.appearance: Dark smooth lines with subtle organic variation

rules: Every major object should have clearly readable contours
Maintain graphic separation between overlapping objects
Favor smooth continuous contours over textured brushstrokes
Use fine internal details without obscuring flat color regions
Apply consistent line treatment across character and environment
Use dark contours rather than metallic-colored outlines

color_system.identity: Muted but colorful fantasy palette using complementary pastel and jewel-tone relationships
color_system.saturation: Low to medium with selective moderately saturated accents
color_system.color_application: Opaque flat fills with soft localized gradient variation
color_system.contrast: Dark outlines and background, lighter subject and floral details
selection_policy: Choose a compact harmonious palette based on the subject
Use one dominant family and a small number of accents
Reserve dark colors for contours, structural elements, and outer background
Use pastel hues inside the ornamental arch
Do not automatically recolor all subjects purple
Preserve recognizable costume colors where needed

shading_and_lighting.shading_method: Two to three softly blended tonal regions per major form
shading_and_lighting.face_shading: Gentle stylized transitions with limited detail
shading_and_lighting.fabric_shading: Broad folded regions with restrained gradients
shading_and_lighting.metal_shading: Simplified graphic highlights and clearly defined segments
shading_and_lighting.flower_shading: Flat petal colors with small inner tonal variations

face.eyes: Clear almond-shaped eyes with expressive dark contours
face.nose: Simplified contour and minimal tonal shading
face.lips: Soft flat color with delicate contour definition

hair.construction: Large flowing locks subdivided by fine contour lines
hair.detail: Stylized strands rather than individually rendered hairs
hair.behavior: Hair can contribute to the ornamental rhythm of the composition

clothing.silhouette: Long, layered, flowing or structurally decorative

materials.fabric: Smooth illustrated folds with elegant contour lines
materials.metal: Flat metallic hues with a few sharp highlights
materials.leather: Simplified dark color regions with fine seams
materials.jewelry: Small flat highlights and graphic geometric shapes

subject_adaptation.stylization_target: Translate recognizable features into the illustration's flat graphic language
do_not: Replace clothing with generic fantasy armor

botanical_design.style: Large flat botanical illustrations with clean dark contours
botanical_design.flower_geometry: Broad simplified petals with delicate interior lines
placement: Overlapping the lower portion of the arch
Framing the head without obscuring it
botanical_design.leaves: Elongated pointed or softly rounded shapes
botanical_design.density: Medium to high, arranged in distinct readable clusters
botanical_design.selection_rule: Choose flowers that support the subject's theme and color palette

background_design.interior_style: Soft muted fills behind the character

celestial_elements.style: Flat graphic circles, crescents, or delicate arcs

background_design.negative_space: Large quiet areas between ornamental clusters
avoid: Gold radial halos as a universal default

ornamental_language.core_principle: Decoration must remain graphic, organic, and integrated into the composition
ornamental_language.ornament_scale: Prefer medium and large motifs over dense micro-detail
ornamental_language.distribution: Concentrate ornament near borders, costumes, and selected focal areas
ornamental_language.hierarchy: Subject first, structural frame second, ornament third

texture.fabric_texture: Suggested by contours rather than realistic material simulation

mandatory_features: Full-body or full-subject composition by default

source_adaptation.principle: Preserve semantic identity, not source rendering complexity.
source_adaptation.subject_independence: Apply the same target illustration language to anime characters, realistic people, animals, objects, and environments.

detail_budget.primary_subject: Preserve recognizable features, pose, silhouette, expression, and signature accessories.
detail_budget.secondary_details: Simplify, merge, or selectively omit details that do not contribute to recognition.
detail_budget.background: Reduce complexity according to foreground density.
detail_budget.ornament: Use available negative space rather than adding decoration uniformly.

complex_source_handling: Identify major visual masses before rendering fine detail.
Consolidate repeated lines and tiny tonal transitions.
Translate source materials into the target illustration technique.
Maintain strong separation between subject, clothing layers, and background.
Avoid retaining source-specific cinematic lighting, digital gloss, or microtexture unless essential to subject identity.
Do not alter the character's recognizable anatomy, outfit design, pose, or distinctive accessories merely to simplify rendering.
source_adaptation.complexity_rule: The more visually complicated the input, the stronger the structural simplification. Do not increase the target style's overall detail density to match the input.

generation_instructions.style_prompt: Transform the subject into a contemporary ornamental fantasy character illustration. Use the visual language of a clean, sophisticated 2D digital illustration with precise dark ink outlines, mostly flat muted colors, subtle simplified shading, and elegant slightly elongated proportions. Present the entire figure within a tall, narrow, rounded architectural arch outlined in pale ivory against a solid dark background. Surround the subject with large stylized flowers, graceful botanical stems, and a restrained number of clean stained-glass-like geometric partitions. Use smooth flowing contours, clear graphic silhouettes, delicate costume details, and soft pastel-jewel color harmony. Render facial features as expressive stylized line art with minimal painterly modeling. Keep the overall design crisp, colorful, clean, balanced, and distinctly modern rather than antiqued. Preserve the original subject's recognizable identity, defining features, clothing, pose, and signature objects wherever possible. The final result should resemble an elegant illustrated fantasy character poster with decorative botanical framing, not a historical painting.
generation_instructions.negative_prompt: photorealism, portrait photography, Renaissance painting, Pre-Raphaelite realism, medieval illuminated manuscript, aged parchment, sepia color grading, gold leaf background, dense golden filigree, heavy grain, weathered paper, engraving, etching, pencil sketch, oil painting, textured watercolor, realistic skin pores, realistic hair strands, complex volumetric lighting, dramatic chiaroscuro, cinematic rendering, 3D, CGI, thick cartoon outlines, chibi proportions, anime cel shading, excessive micro-detail, ornate medieval frame, excessive halos, intricate celestial diagrams, close-up portrait, cropped legs, cropped feet, text, typography, watermark
priority_order: Preserve semantic identity, not source rendering complexity
Use a tall outlined ornamental arch
Avoid antique textures and overly intricate gold decoration

reference_image_usage.style_references: Use the original ornamental fantasy illustrations as the primary authority for linework, rendering, palette, framing, and ornamental density
reference_image_usage.subject_reference: Use the provided character photograph or source image only for character identity, distinctive anatomy, costume, pose, and signature objects
reference_image_usage.composition_adaptation: Allowed to extend the scene to show the full character
reference_image_usage.texture_transfer: Do not transfer photographic texture into the illustration
